active.hypothesis: Increasing RECAP_CARD_TEXT_SIZE will improve readability of recap slides, reinforcing key takeaways and boosting engagement by making the content more digestible and memorable.
active.research_note: Internal data shows 'step-by-step' and 'before-after' formats (which rely heavily on recap slides) have the highest engagement (108.33 and 103.70 avg). External research emphasizes clarity and consistency in carousel design for better retention and interaction.

history.hypothesis: Increasing CTA_COMMENT_SIZE will improve readability of the primary call-to-action, potentially boosting engagement by making the action clearer and more prominent.
history.research_note: Larger CTA text sizes are a common trend in high-engagement Instagram carousels, as they enhance visibility and urgency without altering layout structure.
history.note: Timed out after 26 days without reaching 6 scored posts per arm (had 1 variant / 38 control) — closing as inconclusive rather than leaving it stuck.
